comparator.sourceNotes: Fresh 2 November 2026 source verification of the exact regular Dutch target. Adopted 2026–2027 OER, Articles 8/10/16, Appendix II pp26–29 and Appendix III. Regular Dutch Filosofie, CROHO56081/RIO1015O6459, not English PPS or shortened route. Current curriculum introduced from2025:60EC B1;30EC required B2+15EC three-of-four great texts+15EC open space;10EC required B3+25EC five-of-eight seminars+15EC open space+10EC thesis.180EC. This is the current annual framework, not guaranteed future offerings. Ordinary first-year BSA44EC; PPO1 prerequisite for Project, Project prerequisite for thesis;80% attendance for workgroups/practicals. RADAr and induction0EC.30EC open space subject to approval/overlap rules. Historic4EC transitions and shortened-route rules not mixed. Current faculty OER index links the annual51-page publication, byte-identical to the cited August PDF (SHA256 ece06674881078bb7d9e50761d800bce603adc9ba6b04f0a88ca649196412d03). Articles13/16 and AppendixII pp26–29 independently reconcile150EC major including restricted choices and thesis plus30EC open space. Current framework for entrants2025andlater; no legacy4EC,shortened orPPS requirements imported. Internship is optional within at most15EC open space and requires nominal progression,student-found placement and stagecoordinator approval; other approval/nonoverlap rules apply. Official public year-page prose about two third-year minors is not treated as two additional15EC blocks: current tables/formal regulation control.

alternatives.concept: A philosophical curriculum combining ethics, metaphysics, free will, political thought and close reading with empirical study of perception, cognition and language. Literary interpretation and life writing examine memory, identity and embodied experience alongside philosophical questions about the self. These complementary studies do not replace Radboud’s specialist philosophy seminars or required philosophical thesis.

alternatives.labelRationale: The actual curriculum includes five philosophy courses, political philosophy, logic, cognitive science and interpretation; its label names the substantial philosophical and mind-related combination. Six direct philosophical courses carry45EC; empirical, literary, legal and social courses are separately identified complements, not substitutes for missing philosophical disciplines.

alternatives.concept: An ethics and political philosophy curriculum that tests ideas about justice, authority, rights and responsibility against constitutional and EU institutions, environmental justice and conflict. It exchanges the first curriculum’s sustained cognitive-science and literary interpretation strands for public and social questions supported by Radboud’s social/political philosophy, humanities-in-practice and Planet and Politics components. Philosophy of mind and emotion remain as questions about moral agency.

courseTraceability.rationale: Introduction to Western Philosophy Directly studies historical and contemporary philosophical arguments about knowledge, ethics, mind, freedom, identity, time and meaning through close reading, conceptual analysis and argumentative essays. It implements the explicit academic basis “Ethics, philosophical anthropology and social and political philosophy” and “How ethical and political philosophy engages civic life and the role of humanities scholars in society”.

basisLabels: Philosophical research, independent essay, text analysis and dialogue

alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad first programme treats foundational philosophy through questions of mind, knowledge and human experience. The second changes nine courses and reorganises the evidence around ethics, politics, rights and public life. A third based on philosophical texts or reasoning is already integrated into both and would require unrelated substitutions for a distinct 24-course programme. Interest2160 (philosophy of science) is an explicit coverage gap, not an owned construction generator. The two retained responses have45EC direct philosophy each and differ by9courses/67.5EC; no third alternative is warranted. Fresh current-workbook challenge retained both concepts and the substantive course assessment, while repairing one selection in the first programme and the two organising concepts: each has six dedicated philosophical courses45EC, plus mixed philosophical human-rights study and specifically evidenced complements. All151activecourses considered for stronger philosophical implementation. Clinical psychology/psychopathology add empirical or clinical study rather than a missing specialist philosophy-of-psychiatry sequence; adding them would not establish a third independent concept. Historic seminar examples are not promoted to stable specialisations. Nine distinct courses67.5EC in each programme remain conceptually motivated. Psycholinguistics rescheduled rather than removed; no offering inferred. Life & Travel Writing adds specific memory/identity/embodiment/narrative analysis. Sole-offering Psycholinguistics can only follow autumn2026Brain & Behavior; retaining12autumn-onlycourses would then require13autumnslots. audience.programmeDescription: Study fundamental questions about knowledge, reality, morality and human life through Western philosophical traditions, critical reading, argument and independent philosophical research. This comparison uses the regular Dutch Filosofie curriculum.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Both UCR programmes include 45 EC of direct philosophy: Western philosophy, ethics, mind, emotion, free will and political philosophy. One adds cognition and interpretive reading; the other adds rights, institutions and public life. These are substantive but narrower philosophical routes. Empirical science, literature and legal or social studies complement philosophical inquiry; they do not replace Radboud’s extended philosophical-text sequence, dedicated epistemology and philosophy of science, specialist seminars or required philosophy thesis.

curriculum.limitation: Current annual curriculum; later offerings may change. Restricted choices shown are one permitted selection. RADAr and induction are additional 0-EC requirements.
